title: I Took an At-Home Pet DNA Test Kit and Found Out My Cat Is a Cat
summary: Basepaws offers a single breed and health test for cats that identifies up to 21 breeds, 64 genetic health markers, 50 genetic trait markers, blood type, and oral health. Basepaws tests for oral health by comparing against an oral microbiome database.
